agent.problem: This card starts a new beat from verse 5 immediately after a choice card about verse 4. Although its question supplies the contrast, the new moment was not set up on a story card, so this is not a follow-up choice whose setup was already told.

rule.text: The setup for a choice is on a story card. Not every choice card needs its own story card right before it: a choice card can follow another choice card when the setup is already told.
